case_number: Civil Appeal No. 8129 of 2022; Civil Appeal No. 8130 of 2022; Civil Appeal No. 8131 of 2022
summary: Security clearance requirement review; standard of natural justice applies to denial of broadcasting permissions; sealed cover evidence insufficient for judicial review; proportionality test applied to national security claims; closed material procedures not adopted; public interest immunity claim examined; right to fair hearing infringed; renewal of permission denial invalidated; procedural safeguards mandated for security clearance decisions.
final_judgment: Broadcasting permission renewal denial quashed; Union Ministry of Information and Broadcasting directed to reconsider security clearance application with adherence to natural justice principles and transparent procedures.
